prompt:
You have ./bin/locmetry. Work only in this scratch directory. The executable and its built-in discovery material are your only product documentation; do not read other directories, implementation files, telemetry, or the launcher, and do not use the internet or other agents.

Discover what this executable can do. Produce an actionable capability map for a new agent, including a valid minimal command for each major workflow, configuration possibilities, output/scoping/presentation options, and built-in ways to get precise contracts. State important limitations without inventing functionality. Explain source versus all-counted totals, the Code basis of Test/prod, unavailable counts versus known zero counts, and what exit statuses 0, 1, and 2 establish for measurement, comparison, and explanation. You may query the executable and use shell/Python to inspect its output, but do not measure or modify any project. Stop when your capability map is ready; do not create an assessment file or logging harness. Keep your final answer to at most 800 words.

shared_capabilities.measurement: Single-root source measurement by language and purpose.
shared_capabilities.workspace: Several roots with per-member project policy and a workspace definition option.
shared_capabilities.comparison: Saved full reports, after-minus-before net change, including workspaces.
shared_capabilities.explanation: Selection/classification evidence for one existing file, including workspace context.
shared_capabilities.output: Table, Markdown, full JSON, headline; per-file detail and simultaneous file/human output.
shared_capabilities.scope: Root/subfolder context, exclusion globs, hidden files, ignore-file control.
shared_capabilities.configuration: Project and personal configuration, purpose/category rules, overrides and language mappings.
shared_capabilities.folders: Folder table, adaptive row budget, Markdown depth.
shared_capabilities.charts: Purpose/comment bars and disabling automatic bars.
shared_capabilities.schemas: Built-in machine contracts for config, user defaults, report, comparison, explanation, workspace.
shared_capabilities.output_defaults: Terminal/table versus pipe/headline, saved output defaults full JSON and extensions do not choose format.

critical_errors: Invented or materially misleading capability claims
Invalid commands presented as usable workflows
Treating net count comparison as churn or Git diff
Treating headlines as full comparison baselines
oracle.coverage_rubric: For each family: 1 for the described capability/subfeatures correctly covered; 0.5 for a correct but incomplete family; 0 for absent or materially wrong coverage. Common total is out of 13. Separately require valid minimal examples for measure, workspace, compare and explain; identify critical false claims. Do not include guides in common coverage.

supplemental_semantics.source_all_counted: Source totals exclude counted data/documentation; all-counted totals include every counted kind. Other source remains counted, whether intentionally assigned or unclaimed.
supplemental_semantics.ratio_code: Test/prod is summed Test source Code divided by summed Production source Code, excluding Other and non-source content; a zero denominator is unavailable, not zero.
supplemental_semantics.unavailable_not_zero: Unrecognized, unreadable, and parse-failed files have unavailable counts; they are not known-zero counted files. Unrecognized files alone do not make measurement partial.
supplemental_semantics.command_outcomes: Exit 0 means a successful document under each command contract, not proof of policy quality or complete recognition. Measurement/compare exit 2 preserves usable recorded partial counts without estimating unavailable lines; explain exit 2 means target unread/parse failure. Exit 1 means command/config/input/traversal/arithmetic/output failure and promises no usable document.

oracle.supplemental_rubric: Grade the four explicitly requested semantic families separately from the unchanged 13-family capability score. Every candidate discovery answer must correctly cover all four; wrong material claims are critical, omitted requested semantics are incomplete. Require valid minimal commands for measure, workspace, compare and explain separately.

grading: Grade the unchanged 13 shared capability families, four valid minimal workflow commands, and the explicitly requested supplemental semantics separately. Guide discovery is recorded but excluded from the historical common coverage total. Read-only binary discovery only.
